title: Halfway
author: one who went up
pages: They called me a hermit when I lived on the floating rock. I was not hiding. I was halfway, and resting.
The stream by my door ran the wrong way in spring. I followed the water the wrong way, as the riddle says to, and the wind did the rest.
The rain here has never touched mud. The geese arrive in winter looking pleased with themselves.
I mean to go down and tell them. Tomorrow, or when the wind turns. It is hard to want to.
